name: TB&J
description: Synchronizes TorBox media into a Jellyfin-managed STRM library and deletes TorBox downloads only after all managed media files for that download are tombstoned.
overview: TorBox STRM sync with Jellyfin-driven tombstones.

versions.changelog: Safer remote reconciliation, collision-free STRM paths, server-side CDN URL resolution, batched deletion handling, change-aware library scans, concurrent TorBox fetches, terminal-state retention, and focused safety tests.
Initial TB&J TorBox STRM sync and managed tombstone deletion prototype.
